title: Design exercise: SAA-4.1-S06
scenario: Merrow Veterinary Group runs 60 clinics whose practice-management servers keep records on 14 block volumes and 2 shared file systems. The insurer requires every recovery point to be held for 7 years: one point a month, restored often in its first 35 days and after that only a few times a year, when a wait of up to four days is acceptable. Today the team runs one scheduled script per resource type and cannot show the insurer one retention rule covering all of them. Merrow wants points older than 35 days to cost well below the price of points in their first 35 days.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
The insurer asks for one retention rule that covers every resource type
The operations team will not maintain per-resource scripts
Restores of points older than 35 days may take up to four days

rubric.label: Volumes and file systems follow one schedule and one retention rule, with no script per resource type
Points older than 35 days are stored at a lower rate than the first 35 days' points for the rest of the 7 years, and the day numbers for the change and for deletion are stated

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
